<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import { setContext, type ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import {
  dialogPresentationKey,
  type DialogPresentationContext,
} from "./dialog-context";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Root>;
let {
  children,
  lazyMount = true,
  modal = true,
  open = $bindable(),
  unmountOnExit = true,
  ...rest
}: Props = $props();

setContext<DialogPresentationContext>(dialogPresentationKey, {
  get modal() {
    return modal;
  },
});
</script>

<ArkDialog.Root bind:open {...rest} {lazyMount} {modal} {unmountOnExit}>
  {@render children?.()}
</ArkDialog.Root>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Trigger>;
let { children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ArkDialog.Trigger {...rest} data-slot="dialog-trigger">{@render children?.()}</ArkDialog.Trigger>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import { getContext, type ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { dialogOverlayVariants } from "../_shark/dialog.contract";
import {
  dialogPresentationKey,
  type DialogPresentationContext,
} from "./dialog-context";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Backdrop> & { class?: string };
let { class: className, ...rest }: Props = $props();
const presentation = getContext<DialogPresentationContext>(
  dialogPresentationKey
);
</script>

{#if presentation.modal}
  <ArkDialog.Backdrop {...rest} class={cn(dialogOverlayVariants(), className)} data-slot="dialog-overlay" />
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Positioner> & { class?: string };
let { class: className, children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ArkDialog.Positioner
  {...rest}
  class={cn(
    'fixed inset-0 z-50',
    'h-svh w-screen',
    'grid grid-rows-[1fr_auto_3fr] justify-items-center',
    'p-4',
    className,
  )}
  data-slot="dialog-positioner"
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ArkDialog.Positioner>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import { Portal } from "@ark-ui/svelte/portal";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import type { VariantProps } from "tailwind-variants";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { buttonVariants } from "../_shark/button.contract";
import { dialogContentVariants } from "../_shark/dialog.contract";
import DialogOverlay from "./dialog-overlay.svelte";
import DialogPositioner from "./dialog-positioner.svelte";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Content> &
  VariantProps<typeof dialogContentVariants> & {
    bottomStickOnMobile?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    showCloseButton?: boolean;
  };

let {
  bottomStickOnMobile = true,
  children,
  class: className,
  showCloseButton = true,
  size = "md",
  ...rest
}: Props = $props();
</script>

<Portal>
  <DialogOverlay />
  <DialogPositioner class={cn(bottomStickOnMobile && 'max-sm:grid-rows-[1fr_auto] max-sm:p-0 max-sm:pt-12')}>
    <ArkDialog.Content
      {...rest}
      class={cn(dialogContentVariants({ bottomStickOnMobile, size }), className)}
      data-slot="dialog-content"
    >
      {@render children?.()}
      {#if showCloseButton}
        <ArkDialog.CloseTrigger
          aria-label="Close"
          class={cn(
            buttonVariants({ size: 'icon-sm', variant: 'ghost' }),
            'absolute inset-e-2 top-2 opacity-64 hover:opacity-100',
          )}
          data-slot="dialog-close-trigger"
        >
          <svg aria-hidden="true" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" />
          </svg>
        </ArkDialog.CloseTrigger>
      {/if}
    </ArkDialog.Content>
  </DialogPositioner>
</Portal>
{@render children?.()}
{#if title}{title}{/if} {#if description}{description}{/if} {#if !title}{@render children?.()}{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Title> & { class?: string };
let { children, class: className, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ArkDialog.Title {...rest} class={cn('font-heading font-semibold text-lg leading-none', className)} data-slot="dialog-title">{@render children?.()}</ArkDialog.Title>

import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.Description> & { class?: string };
let { children, class: className, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ArkDialog.Description {...rest} class={cn('text-muted-foreground text-sm', className)} data-slot="dialog-description">{@render children?.()}</ArkDialog.Description>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog as ArkDialog } from "@ark-ui/svelte/dialog";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof ArkDialog.CloseTrigger>;
let { children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ArkDialog.CloseTrigger {...rest} data-slot="dialog-close-trigger">{@render children?.()}</ArkDialog.CloseTrigger>
{@render children?.()}
